title: Harness audit rule catalog
responsibility: Defines the standard audit limits and expresses supplied limits as human-readable rule summaries.

inputs.name: harnessRuleSummariesFor.limits
inputs.description: Numeric limits for file, function, class and method lines, nesting, parameters, complexity and classes per file.

outputs.name: harnessRuleLimits
outputs.description: Default limits: 220 file lines, 55 function lines, 120 class lines, 35 method lines, nesting 4, parameters 4, complexity 10 and one class per file.

outputs.name: harnessRuleSummaries
outputs.description: Rule summary strings generated from the default limits, followed by fixed naming, structure, dependency and coverage guidance.

outputs.name: harnessRuleSummariesFor
outputs.description: Ordered rule summaries using the supplied numeric limits together with the fixed Harness guidance; no files are inspected or changed.
